description: This file contains the PHP class Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Account\Tracking, which handles user interactions related to account tracking, including viewing tracking details and autocomplete functionality for searches. It extends the base engine controller and manages request routing, view rendering, and response output for tracking-related actions.

classes.name: Tracking
classes.description: Controller class for handling account tracking functionalities, including viewing tracking details and providing autocomplete suggestions based on search and tracking input.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method for displaying the tracking page. It checks customer login status, handles redirections, loads necessary models and language files, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and renders the tracking view.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides JSON response with search and tracking suggestions based on user input. Handles request validation, fetches product results, and outputs the data in JSON format.
